# Command reference

<!-- Generated by `uv run python -m scripts.gen_command_docs`. Do not edit by hand: a test fails
     when this file does not match the bot's real commands. -->

Aha is used through Discord's slash commands (there are no message commands: the bot does not read
messages). This is every command, generated from the bot itself and shown here in English; Discord
shows names and option texts in the user's language where the catalogue has a translation (see
[i18n.md](i18n.md)).

Besides each command's own cooldown, every user is limited to **10 command uses per 10
seconds across all commands** (per bot process).

Replies to commands that show personal data or settings are only visible to you. Commands that need
a database (`/remind`, `/watch`, `/config` and others) say so when the bot runs without one. For the
HTTP endpoints of the bot process itself (probes and metrics) see [openapi.yaml](openapi.yaml).

## Info

### `/about`

Show the bot's version, uptime and status.

*cooldown: 1 per 10 s per user.*

### `/forgetme`

Delete everything Aha stores about you.

*cooldown: 1 per 30 s per user.*

### `/help`

List available commands.

*cooldown: 3 per 10 s per user.*

### `/ping`

Check the bot's WebSocket latency.

*cooldown: 1 per 5 s per user.*

### `/privacy`

Show what the bot stores and where the policy is.

*cooldown: 1 per 10 s per user.*

### `/remind`

Remind you of something later.

| Option | Required | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| `when` | yes | How long from now, like 30m, 2h or 1d 12h. |
| `what` | yes | What to say. |

Usage: `/remind <when> <what>`

*cooldown: 1 per 5 s per user.*

### `/reminders`

List your reminders.

*cooldown: 1 per 5 s per user.*

### `/unremind`

Cancel one of your reminders.

| Option | Required | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| `reminder` | yes | The reminder to cancel. |

Usage: `/unremind <reminder>`

*cooldown: 1 per 5 s per user.*

### `/unwatch`

Stop getting reminders for a show.

| Option | Required | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| `show` | yes | The show to stop following. |

Usage: `/unwatch <show>`

*cooldown: 1 per 5 s per user.*

### `/url`

Show a preview of a web page.

| Option | Required | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| `link` | yes | The http(s) link to preview. |

Usage: `/url <link>`

*cooldown: 1 per 15 s per user.*

### `/watch`

Get a reminder when a show's next episode comes out.

| Option | Required | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| `show` | yes | The show to follow (pick one from the list). |
| `where` | no | Where to remind you. Direct messages are private. Choices: `dm` (Direct message); `channel` (Ping me in this channel). |
| `lead` | no | Remind you this long before, like 30m or 1d. Default: when it airs. |

Usage: `/watch <show> [where] [lead]`

*cooldown: 1 per 10 s per user.*

### `/watching`

List the shows you get reminders for.

*cooldown: 1 per 5 s per user.*

## Fun

### `/8ball`

Ask the magic 8-ball a question.

| Option | Required | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| `question` | yes | What you want to know. |

Usage: `/8ball <question>`

*cooldown: 1 per 5 s per user.*

### `/coin`

Flip a coin.

*cooldown: 1 per 5 s per user.*

### `/countdown`

Count down to a date.

| Option | Required | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| `when` | yes | A date or time like 2026-12-25 or 2026-12-25 18:00 (UTC unless it has an offset). |
| `label` | no | What you are counting down to. |

Usage: `/countdown <when> [label]`

*cooldown: 1 per 5 s per user.*

### `/join`

Join your voice channel.

*cooldown: 1 per 5 s per user; servers only.*

### `/leave`

Leave the voice channel.

*cooldown: 1 per 5 s per user; servers only.*

### `/play`

Play a YouTube link in your voice channel.

| Option | Required | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| `link` | yes | A YouTube video link. |

Usage: `/play <link>`

*cooldown: 1 per 5 s per user; servers only.*

### `/poll`

Start a poll people can vote in.

| Option | Required | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| `question` | yes | What you are asking. |
| `options` | yes | The answers, separated by commas (2 to 10). |
| `duration` | no | Hours the poll stays open (1 to 768, default 24). |
| `multi` | no | Let people pick more than one answer. |

Usage: `/poll <question> <options> [duration] [multi]`

*cooldown: 1 per 30 s per user.*

### `/roll`

Roll a die.

| Option | Required | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| `sides` | no | How many sides the die has (1 to 1,000,000, default 6). |

Usage: `/roll [sides]`

*cooldown: 1 per 5 s per user.*

### `/summarize`

Summarize a piece of text (off until a server admin enables it).

| Option | Required | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| `text` | yes | The text to summarize. |

Usage: `/summarize <text>`

*cooldown: 1 per 20 s per user; servers only.*

### `/time`

Show the current time in a timezone.

| Option | Required | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| `tz` | no | An IANA timezone such as Europe/Berlin (default UTC). |

Usage: `/time [tz]`

*cooldown: 1 per 5 s per user.*

## Admin

### `/config`

Show this server's settings.

*cooldown: 1 per 5 s per server; servers only; needs: Manage Guild.*

### `/configure`

Change a server setting.

| Option | Required | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| `setting` | yes | What to change. Choices: `log-channel`; `disable`; `enable`; `summaries`. |
| `value` | yes | A channel (or off), a command for disable/enable, or on/off for summaries. |

Usage: `/configure <setting> <value>`

*cooldown: 1 per 5 s per server; servers only; needs: Manage Guild.*

## Context menus

### Count reactions (message menu)

Right-click a message: **Apps → Count reactions**.

### Summarize (message menu)

Right-click a message: **Apps → Summarize**.
